title: Dog Night, 2025
logline: Twenty-six years. The dumpster. The sign — how many letters, reserved; most dark. The pup, eleven. A man's back. Rain. No caption, like every private Dog Night.

panels.composition: The alley behind the Lanes in rain, the dumpster, the man from behind in a rain shell now over the flannel, the old dog sitting close against his leg for warmth. The sign above with nearly every tube dark — the word a gap. The lot beyond the alley mouth empty. No caption.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a rain-soaked alley behind a bowling alley at night with a dumpster, a man seen from behind in a rain shell with an old three-legged dog pressed against his leg, the neon sign above with nearly every letter dark so the word reads as a gap, an empty lot beyond, no words
image.notes: Letters lit: reserved; nearly none. No caption.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
